Name: MAP_PIECE_TEX_PARAM_ST
Description: Save location name and multiplayer area per part of the overworld (m60). The game reads the map info texture of the 1024 m tile the player is on (256 × 256 pixels, 4 m per pixel, north up): the red channel of the pixel under the player is the row ID (0–255). No row for that value: both fields count as -1.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Parameters marked with  are excluded in the NT version package.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Red
Fields.Description: Red of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Green
Fields.Description: Green of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Blue
Fields.Description: Blue of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself.

Fields.Name: Save Map Name ID
Fields.Description: PlaceName text recorded as the player's current location name while in this area (kept separately from the on-screen place-name banner). -1: uses the MapNameTexParam place name with its sign removed. A location name set by the game (event or map override) takes precedence.

Fields.Name: Multiplayer Area ID
Fields.Description: PlayRegionParam row that becomes the current play region (multiplayer area) while the player is in this area. -1: the play region is derived from the map ID instead. A play region set by the game (event or map override) takes precedence.
